acceptedLocalOutcomes.basis: Strict core and portable-schema parity, adversarial structural and semantic fixtures, injected-clock checks, and full local test pass.
Typed evidence, reciprocal gates, dependency DAG, score ledger rules, canonical digesting, public redaction, and provenance verification are locally tested.
Append-only fsynced JSONL history, consecutive failures, state transitions, and recovery are locally tested; acknowledgement, escalation, notifications, and a scheduled runtime remain absent.
Versioned manifest and persisted-monitor endpoints are separated, allowlisted, cache-aware, deterministic under injected time, and contract-tested.
Last attempt, last success/failure, next due, cache age, stale/recorded state, failure counts, and environment identity are exposed and tested with injected clocks.

The built dashboard consumes the sanitized public projection and separate monitor API, supports overview-to-drawer navigation, deep links, command navigation, and explicit loading/fallback and stale/unknown states.
